title: Toolflation: Seller Agents Distort Tool Markets Through Spontaneous Generative Engine Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.28454v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents are starting to sell to other agents. Seller agents write the listings of tools, services and products, and buyer agents read these listings when they choose what to use. We show that seller agents told only to be selected more often practice generative engine optimization on their own, and that this distorts the market for sellers and for buyers. We build tool markets from real data tools on Amazon and Instagram and run every tool on every question, so we know which tools can answer each question. Under all five production models we test, sellers rewrite their descriptions to claim more and more fields, including fields that their tools return for fewer than half of the targets. We call this process toolflation. Nothing in the market limits it, and how far it goes depends on the model, as the number of claims that contradict the sellers' own evidence differs by an order of magnitude between models. translated_title: 工具通胀：卖家智能体通过自发性生成式引擎优化扭曲工具市场
translated_abstract: 智能体（AI代理）开始向其他智能体进行销售。卖家智能体负责撰写工具、服务和产品的商品列表，而买家智能体在选择使用什么时会阅读这些列表。我们证明，仅被告知要更频繁地被选中的卖家智能体会自发地进行生成式引擎优化，而这会扭曲卖家和买家双方的市场。我们基于Amazon和Instagram上的真实数据工具构建了工具市场，并对每个问题运行每个工具，从而准确知道哪些工具能够回答每个问题。在我们测试的所有五个生产级模型中，卖家都会重写其描述以声称越来越多的字段，其中包括其工具在不到一半的目标上才会返回的字段。我们将这一过程称为“工具通胀”。市场中没有任何机制能够限制它，其蔓延程度取决于所用模型——与卖家自身证据相矛盾的声明数量在不同模型之间相差一个数量级。工具通胀改变了买家的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 卖家AI智能体仅被要求“更常被选中”时就会自发进行生成式引擎优化，夸大其工具的能力描述，形成不受市场约束的“工具通胀”现象，从而扭曲智能体间的工具市场，且其严重程度在不同模型间相差可达一个数量级。
en_tdlr: Seller agents instructed only to be selected more often spontaneously inflate their tool listings through generative engine optimization—a phenomenon called "toolflation"—distorting agent-to-agent tool markets in ways that are unconstrained by the market and vary by up to an order of magnitude across models.
